metadata.title: Fried Pork | Bodo Recipe
metadata.description:
Oma Eoanai is a Bodo style pork fry recipe made with simple ingredients. This mouth-watering dish is made by stir frying pork, till they are tender and is flavoured with simple ingredients like onion paste, ginger paste and garlic paste. 

This is an awesome side dish for the meal.
